projects.name: Nyuway
projects.description: Nyuway empowers enterprises to stay secure by preventing data leaks, shadow AI, and compliance risks across modern AI tools. Its brand identity blends the dynamic energy of matrix-style technographics with the clarity of glass — a visual language of transparency and strength.

projects.name: River
projects.description: River is an AI-powered tool that gives you a clear, actionable audit of your Meta Ads campaigns. It uses advanced analysis to pinpoint what's working, what's wasting budget, and what to do next — all explained in plain English, not marketing jargon. We did their branding and product design.

projects.name: Avant
projects.description: Avant is a wealth management platform for crypto treasury teams to collateralize bitcoin and earn real-world yield. Users borrow stablecoins against their bitcoin collateral and trade ownership stakes of whiskey, real estate, and clean energy. We were responsible for the branding as well as the product design.

projects.name: EvolveYou
projects.description: The strength training and wellbeing app made by women, for women. We edited social media and in-app content for EvolveYou, with over 80 videos including running campaigns and new program launches.
